column3: Inspect all deployed hooks/reflexes for mesh-mind-recycle; if no activation exists, wire shadow-first busy-to-idle handling through mesh-clear, then verify source/deployed parity, the actual trigger path, unsafe-gate refusal, and live shadow status. Do not enable live clears before the gate evidence passes.

In a dedicated SHADOW/test window (never a live mind), conduct the real P4 recovery drill with dirty tracked/untracked work and no fresh manual handoff: kill the test engine, reincarnate from P1/P2 artifacts, and verify the recovered thread. Record the actual recovered session; add separate /clear and simulated-reboot cases (fresh session, cleared tmpfs handoff, intact .git). Stop if a dedicated test window cannot be proven isolated.
